title: Clear script GC weak entries
summary: Recover the linked-table weak array and hash traversal at 0x4f1900, including mark-bit changes and hash tombstones.
test_description: Compare original and recovered routines on null, 10000 deterministic linked-table fixtures, and exhaustive combinations of eight signed tags and 16 flag patterns for array, hash key and hash value; compare all fixture fields and FS head restoration.
known_limits: Table and tag names are descriptive; their broader runtime meanings remain unconfirmed.
Valid pointers, acyclic table chains and suitably sized arrays and hash storage are assumed, as in the original.
Large hash exponents and faulting inputs are not exercised.
